_note: Fictional Riverbend Physical Therapy home exercise videos. Each line is one narrated segment and one title card. `facts` are the clinically critical facts a dub must keep: numbers (sets, reps, hold/rest seconds, times per day), the side of the body, and the safety line.

segments.say: Glute bridges. Lie on your back with both knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
card: Lie on your back, knees bent

segments.say: Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips. Hold for 5 seconds.
Stop if you feel sharp pain in your back or hips.
card: Stop if you feel sharp pain

segments.say: Heel slides. This exercise is for your left knee only.
Lie on your back. Slowly slide your left heel toward you until you feel a gentle stretch. Hold for 3 seconds.
Slide it back out. Do 15 reps.
Stop if you feel sharp pain in your knee.
card: Stop if you feel sharp pain

segments.say: Wall push-ups. Stand about an arm's length from a wall.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height. Bend your elbows and bring your chest toward the wall, then push back.
Do 3 sets, and rest 30 seconds between sets.
Stop if you feel sharp pain in your shoulder.
card: Stop if you feel sharp pain
